extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily mobilization (Days 1-8), conditioning (1 day), transplant (1 day), daily post-transplant monitoring (Days 1-29), then follow-up visits at Day 30, 60, 100, 180, 270 post-transplant.

The 'Daily until engraftment' period is counted as 29 consecutive days as defined in the SoA (Visit 10 Day 1-29).
Visit 16 (12 months post-transplant) falls outside the 365-day window from treatment start (Day 1 of mobilization) due to the preceding mobilization and conditioning phases.
